words.gloss: so as to be revealed only at the end
that which is fit to be done
if it is revealed in the middle

literal: To do that which is fit to be done so as to be revealed only at the end is strength of character; if it is revealed in the middle, it will bring irreparable distress.
translation: True determination lies in performing an action so that it is revealed only upon completion; if the secret leaks out midway, it will bring irreparable ruin.
modern: ஒரு செயலை அது முடியும் வரை வெளியே தெரியாமல் செய்து முடிப்பதே ஆண்மையாகும்; அது நடுவிலேயே வெளிப்பட்டுவிட்டால், அது நீக்க முடியாத பெரும் துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of maintaining secrecy and focus when executing a plan. True strength of character, or 'āṇmai', is shown when a person carries out a necessary task in such a way that it is only made public at the very end. If the plans or actions are revealed prematurely in the middle of execution, it will lead to failure and bring about irreparable ruin. Thus, confidentiality and quiet execution are vital components of resolute action.
